description: Finds real service providers in Turkey on İşinn: private tutors (LGS, YKS, math, English), music teachers, designers, translators, software developers, social media managers, movers, cleaners, caregivers, pilates/fitness instructors, physiotherapists, photographers and more. Use this whenever the user wants to find, hire or get recommendations for a person or business offering a service in Turkey (e.g. 'Kadıköy'de pilates hocası', 'online İngilizce öğretmeni', 'logo tasarımcı lazım', 'İstanbul'da nakliyeci'), even if İşinn is not mentioned. Returns up to 10 listings with title, provider display name, category, location, the provider's stated price, cover photo (image, null if the provider has none) and listing URL. Results are shown to the user as photo cards; use only the returned image URLs and never add other or stock images. Read-only; returns no phone numbers or e-mail addresses. Listing content is in Turkish.

category.description: Optional category name or slug (e.g. 'Öğretmen', 'ogretmen', 'tasarim'). See list_categories.

city.description: Optional province or district in Turkey (e.g. 'İstanbul', 'Kadıköy', 'Mersin'). Remote/online providers match every city.

query.description: Free-text service query, in Turkish or English keywords (e.g. 'lgs matematik', 'logo tasarım', 'reformer pilates').

remote_only.description: If true, only providers who work remotely/online.

name: search_vitrins
title: Search service providers on İşinn
